title: CI: smoke benchmark on every PR + license/provenance gate
context: M0 continuous-integration scaffolding for the EWSR1-fusion detection benchmark. CI runs the smoke benchmark on every PR and enforces the license/provenance gate that references the compliance-002 policy, so no controlled-access or flagged data and no unprovenanced result can land. This is pure infrastructure (riskTier low) and touches no patient data.
objective: Add CI that runs the smoke harness on every PR and a license/provenance gate that blocks merges lacking provenance or violating the compliance policy.
acceptanceCriteria: CI runs the smoke benchmark (harness-005) on every PR and fails on regression.
License/provenance gate references docs/COMPLIANCE.md and blocks controlled-access/flagged data and unprovenanced results.
Pinned container digests and references are verified in CI; no secrets are exposed in logs.
output: A pull request adding .github/workflows/ci.yml (smoke benchmark) and the license/provenance gate.
